name: ledger-ocr
purpose: For a PDF or image that needs text extraction, run Ledger-OCR first, then give the extracted text/JSON to the model instead of asking it to read the source document directly
note: Set tools.ledgerOcrCommand to an executable or launcher path, including a dev checkout, to override discovery; set it to an empty value to disable the capability

name: tesseract
purpose: OCR: turns a scanned page or screenshot into text, deterministic and far cheaper than a model reading an image

name: pdftotext
purpose: The text layer of a PDF (poppler): exact text with layout for zero model tokens; OCR only when the PDF is a scan

name: yt-dlp
purpose: Downloads a YouTube video's captions (subtitles only, no video) so a text model can read the transcript for zero video tokens

name: ffmpeg
purpose: Audio/video conversion and frame extraction (one frame at a timestamp, or the audio track for transcription)

name: openscad
purpose: Renders parametric CAD (.scad) to STL; the modeling recipe builds on it

name: potrace
purpose: Traces a bitmap into vector paths (SVG): the trace step of the modeling recipe

name: youtube
purpose: The task has a YouTube link. Route transcript extraction to a Gemini model through the Antigravity provider; other models can work from the extracted transcript. For a FINANCIAL briefing, use variant video-finance; otherwise use video-general
note: Antigravity is the in-Conductor Gemini route for YouTube transcript extraction; the deterministic benchmark uses a checked-in transcript and never fetches a live video

name: x
purpose: The task contains an X/Twitter link, which must be opened by Grok
